title: Challenge 4 Quiz - AI for Business Growth

questions.question: How can AI improve customer service?
options: By answering common customer questions automatically

questions.question: Which of the following is a common AI customer service tool?
Which task can AI assist with in sales and marketing?
Why is personalized marketing important?
options: It helps deliver more relevant messages to customers
It removes the need for human review
It guarantees every customer will buy

questions.question: What is business automation?
options: Using technology to perform repetitive tasks automatically

questions.question: Which of the following is an example of a task AI can automate?
Why is human oversight still important when using AI?
options: Humans must review important decisions and sensitive situations

questions.question: An AI-powered business system combines:
options: Multiple AI tools working together to improve business operations

questions.question: What should businesses do after implementing AI systems?
options: Regularly review and improve their performance

questions.question: Which statement best describes the role of AI in business?
options: AI supports people by improving productivity and efficiency.
AI removes the need for customer service.
